**Global Citizenship Lab** is a student-led research and action group composed of my undergraduate advisees at Soka University. The Lab explores education, policy, and practical initiatives that advance sustainable development and global citizenship, often working collaboratively with students and partners both in Japan and abroad.

For more information, please visit our [**Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/shunchonabayashi_seminar) and [**website**](https://www.globalcitizenshiplab.com/) (available in Japanese).

## Recent achievements

- **2026:** Excellence Awards (Types A and B) and an Effort Award (Type A), SDGs Good Practice Awards, Chonabayashi Seminar.
- **2025:** Newcomer Award, CAS-Net Japan Sustainable Campus Awards, for "Promoting Environmentally Responsible Student Behaviors at Soka University." [CAS-Net award announcement](https://casnet-japan.org/info/6513210) · [Soka University news](https://www.soka.ac.jp/news/2025/11/1114-1/) (in Japanese).
- **2025:** Kimihiro Horinouchi and Sachie Iijima, students in the Chonabayashi Seminar, received the AAERE Best Poster Award for "Mitigating the use of disposable cutlery with bring-your-own-cutlery discounts." [AAERE award announcement](https://aaere.org/student-poster-awards/) · [Soka University news (in Japanese)](https://www.soka.ac.jp/news/2025/09/20250917/).
- **2025:** A university press release featured the Seminar's AI-assisted food-waste reduction project at Soka University. [Soka University press release](https://www.soka.ac.jp/news/2025/11/1126-1/) (in Japanese).

## Selected student placements

Overseas graduate study destinations for recent undergraduate students include Wageningen University & Research's M.Sc. in Sustainability Economics and the University of Bonn's M.Sc. in Economics (2026).

Domestic destinations include the University of Tokyo's Master of Public Policy program and Yokohama National University's M.A. in Economics (2026), and Keio University's Master of System Design and Management (2024).

Graduate students and research associates I have mentored have progressed to the University of Warwick, the World Bank, Bangladesh Agricultural University, and Alibaba Group. See my [CV](cv.html) for individual placements and dates.

## High-school inquiry and outreach

I have taught and mentored student inquiry projects through Soka High School's Global Citizenship Inquiry Studies (GCIS) since 2021.

In June 2026, I gave a University Partnership lecture at Kansai Soka High School on climate change, economic growth, environmental conservation, and career pathways.
